metadata.api_cache_definition: First versus immediate repeat per Site/resource; server caches retained
metadata.automatic_prefetch: Normal Next prefetch is retained; pre-initiation traffic is outside a measured navigation window
metadata.cold_definition: fresh browser context and HTTP cache; target Site absent from Next router cache; application/database caches retained
metadata.warm_definition: same browser context; previously visited target; no forced invalidation
metadata.session_policy: Independent real Keycloak browser sign-in before every cold/warm iteration; login is excluded from timings; each pair uses one active session
metadata.authentication_role: Site Administrator on the 10 benchmark Sites; no platform role
metadata.sampling_warning: SMOKE: p95 is a small-sample diagnostic; use >=30 per scenario for acceptance.
